faq

Questions? Answered.

How much does a website cost?+

Landing pages are $1,000 flat, custom sites run $2,000–$5,000, and systems are quoted per system. Every project gets a fixed quote up front. See pricing.

Do you do Google Ads or SEO?+

I set up the basics every site needs: your Google Business Profile, page titles, and a fast, phone-friendly site. I don't run ad campaigns. My focus is what happens after someone finds you: making it easy to book, buy, or join, and making it easy for your team to keep up.

How long does it take?+

Most sites go live in about 12 days from the start of the project. Bigger builds with lots of systems can take longer, and I'll tell you up front.

Can you fix my current site instead of starting over?+

Yes. I can refresh what you have, or just fix what's connected to it, like your Google Business Profile, booking, or payments.

What do I need to provide?+

Not much. A short call, your logo and photos if you have them, and quick feedback. I write the copy and handle the tech.

How does payment work?+

50% to start, 50% at launch. The Care Plan is billed monthly after launch.

What happens after launch?+

With the Care Plan, I keep your site hosted, secure, and up to date, and handle small changes for you. You're never stuck with a site you can't update.
